fusions.name: Thundering Pod
fusions.desc: The pod thunders through around you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, and every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Pounding Stride
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A heavy blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Swell
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Coast Road Run
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 10%.
